channel.title: Pier & Point · P27
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P27 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P27: P27 no longer shows a 'complete, September 2026' date. It rested only on Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery of an oval that is probably Mariposa Park (P26); no source says P27 was built.

item.title: Correction · P27: A September 2026 accuracy check found that nothing supports labelling the traced oval track as OCII parcel P27. It sits where Mariposa Park is (Potrero View, 2016-03-19, and SF Rec & Park's Mariposa Park page), OCII numbers Mariposa Park P26, and OCII's September 2023 deck lists P27 as not yet built. The record's name, map shape, status (complete) and 2026-09 milestone have not been changed; the identity question is noted on the record and remains open. The OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name), and the aerial photo credit names only the Wikimedia Commons username Firstcultural.
